_comment: Clip W1 (recording_shot_list.md): moving along a wall at speed, airborne, one neutral wall jump (no move keys).
The sim starts airborne next to a long wall (T26 geometry, lengthened) with the incoming velocity in start.vel_mps
(Godot frame: forward is -Z, up is +Y). Set that velocity to what the video shows just before the jump
(speed_h and vel_v at t0), then line up the jump tick.
h_along / h_across split the horizontal velocity along/across the incoming direction (measured in
align.ref_window, before the jump), which separates tangential keep (G03) from the kick (G32).
Alignment: first rising crossing of vel_v through value_u (the wall jump) in video and sim.
name: Neutral wall jump at speed (W1)
